blocks.text: Bubble Sort sab se saade sorting algorithms mein se hai. Yeh list mein baar baar shuru se aakhir tak chalta hai, saath saath wale (adjacent) elements ko compare karta hai, aur agar woh ghalat tarteeb mein hon to unhein swap karta hai (jagah badal deta hai). Yeh process list sort hone tak dohraya jata hai.

items: Har saath wale jore (adjacent pair) ko compare karein.
Agar woh ghalat tarteeb mein hon to swap karein.
Yeh process tab tak jari rakhein jab tak aur swap ki zaroorat na rahe.

blocks.text: Misal: list [5,3,8,4,2] lein. Bubble Sort 5 aur 3 ko compare kar ke unhein swap karega, phir agle jore par jayega, aur isi tarah. List mein se kai chakkar (passes) ke baad algorithm list ko [2,3,4,5,8] bana dega.

blocks.caption: [5, 3, 8, 4, 2] par Bubble Sort ke chakkar (hamara hal kiya hua, chala kar jaancha gaya)
rows: koi swap nahi: list sort ho chuki

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har chakkar mein baqi elements mein se sab se bara element bulbule (bubble) ki tarah aakhir tak pohanch jata hai: pehle chakkar ke baad 8 aakhir mein hai, doosre ke baad 5 apni jagah par, waghaira.
Yeh program har chakkar (pass) ke baad list print karta hai, jaise upar wali table mein. numbers list badal kar Run karein aur dekhein kitne chakkar lagte hain.

numbers = [5, 3, 8, 4, 2]

def bubble_sort(items):
    pass_no = 0
    swapped = True
    while swapped:
        swapped = False
        pass_no += 1
        for i in range(len(items) - 1):
            if items[i] > items[i + 1]:                           # wrong order?
                items[i], items[i + 1] = items[i + 1], items[i]   # swap
                swapped = True
        if swapped:
            print("Pass", pass_no, ":", items)
        else:
            print("Pass", pass_no, ": no swap, list is sorted")
    return items

print("Sorted:", bubble_sort(list(numbers)))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"numbers = [5, 3, 8, 4, 2]": sort karne wali list.
"swapped = True" aur "while swapped:": jab tak kisi chakkar (pass) mein swap hota rahe, naya chakkar chalta hai.
"swapped = False" aur "pass_no += 1": har chakkar ke shuru mein farz karo koi swap nahi hoga, aur chakkar ginte jao.
"for i in range(len(items) - 1):": saath saath wale har jore ko dekhta hai.
"if items[i] > items[i + 1]:" aur swap: ghalat tarteeb ho to jagah badal kar "swapped = True".
"if swapped: print(...) else: print(\"... no swap, list is sorted\")": har chakkar ke baad list, ya batata hai ke ab list sorted hai.
Output: "Pass 1 : [3, 5, 4, 2, 8]", "Pass 2 : [3, 4, 2, 5, 8]", "Pass 3 : [3, 2, 4, 5, 8]", "Pass 4 : [2, 3, 4, 5, 8]", "Pass 5 : no swap, list is sorted" aur "Sorted: [2, 3, 4, 5, 8]". Har pass mein sab se bara bacha hua number aakhir tak chala jata hai.
Khud try karein: numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] kar ke Run karein: pehle hi pass mein "no swap, list is sorted" aa jayega.

Complexity: Bubble Sort ki time complexity O(n²) hai, is liye bare datasets ke liye yeh efficient nahi. Lekin yeh samajhna aur banana aasan hai, is liye parhai (educational) ke maqsad aur chhote datasets ke liye faidemand hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Bubble Sort banana aasan hai, magar bare datasets ke liye waqt aur resources bachane ki khatir Quick Sort ya Merge Sort jaise zyada efficient sorting algorithms istemal karein.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa algorithm list mein baar baar chal kar ghalat tarteeb wale saath wale elements swap kar ke data sort karta hai (MCQ 7)?
Bubble Sort ka process aur time complexity samjhaiye aur kisi aur sorting algorithm se efficiency ko compare kijiye (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: Har chakkar har saath wale jore ko compare kar ke ghalat tarteeb wale swap karta hai, is liye baqi elements mein sab se bari qeemat aakhir tak pohanch jati hai; zyada se zyada n − 1 chakkar, har ek mein zyada se zyada n − 1 comparisons, to O(n²) waqt. Merge Sort list ko aadhon mein baant kar sort karta aur jorta hai: O(n log n). 1,000 elements par Bubble Sort ko taqreeban 500,000 comparisons, Merge Sort ko sirf taqreeban 10,000; is liye bari lists ke liye Merge Sort kahin behtar hai, jabke Bubble Sort saada hai aur extra memory nahi leta.

items: Bubble Sort: chakkar ba chakkar saath wale jore swap karo; [5, 3, 8, 4, 2] se [2, 3, 4, 5, 8]; O(n²).
